storyInfo: Hadiya, leaving the immigrant community of 57th Street for the very first time, seeks an opportunity to prove herself. But after one rainy night, reality will point the way for her heart.

attributes.text: Children of the wilds, where does your road lead?
Desert of blazing winds, how many have been lost in your sands?
Your final choice, is it where your heart truly points?

attributes.content: Good afternoon, sir!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: The young Caprinae pants as she pushes open the glass door, stepping into the bar's gentle light.
The only other person in the establishment is a man behind the counter, startled by her entrance.
Oh, err, hey, miss.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Sorry, but we're not open yet.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Come back in the evening—
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: N-No, I'm not here for a drink.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Are you still hiring security?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: The owner's eyes widen for a moment, but he soon walks out from behind the counter, stretching out a hand.
Oh, so that's what this was about. Well, come on then, have a seat.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Here, water.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Th-Thank you.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I saw the poster stuck to the board downstairs, and ran up as fast as I could.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: This place is... really nice. A proper downtown bar.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Whoops, I forgot to even ask your name.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm Clarson, but just Clars will do.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm Hadiya Talun, sir.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Alright then, Miss Talun.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You can put those, err... weapons aside. We're just talking for now.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Oh, sorry, the last few places I applied to wanted me to demonstrate my... Err...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: My 'ability to respond to emergencies'.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: And I feel more confident with them around, so...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Personally, what I look for most in a bouncer is professionalism.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm not here to hire brawlers. I don't want you talking with your fists.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You don't need to worry about that, Mr. Clars.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I'm not some hot-headed thug or anything. Look, these are my certificates.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Hadiya takes out a folder and passes it across the table to Clars, who is sitting on the sofa.
Huh. Never seen someone in this line of work come this prepared.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Let's see here...
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Training certifications... Weapon handling licenses...
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: This is pretty comprehensive. Some of my friends have combat training, but you hardly ever see a resume as spotless this one.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: To be frank, qualifications like these could get you into a legit security firm.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Not sure why you'd settle for being a bouncer.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I prefer more relaxed places like this, and I like this kind of work.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (Quietly) Besides... the security firms never called back...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Hmm? You say something?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Ah, nonono.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I was just saying the job market's not so great right now, even for security work.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I've visited a lot of places, but unfortunately none of them decided to hire me.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Well, that's weird.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Surely a resume like this would open a lot of doors?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You'd think so, right? But the interviewers always said I wasn't tall enough, or intimidating enough.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Some of them even cut off the interview before we finished, for whatever reason.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Well, it's definitely not a problem with you, Miss Talun. They're the ones who wouldn't know talent if it bit 'em.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Whether it's your appearance or your experience, I've got no complaints at least.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Now, with that out of the way, let's talk wages and hours. If they work for you, you can start as soon as tomorrow.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Really? Thank you, sir.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: This is the first time the hiring process had gone so smoothly. I'm glad I stuck it out for one more application.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Haha, means you found the right place.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Do you know how long it took to convince my folks to let me start a business, back in the day? People need to believe in themselves, and have the courage to take on new challenges.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You're absolutely right. My family always hoped I'd carry on their mission with the same determination.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: To tell you the truth, I've struggled a lot with whether I should or not, but now that I've found what I want to do, things couldn't be better.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: That's exactly what I'm talking about!
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Okay, let's talk hours first. Your shift is from 8pm until 4am. I take it you have no objections to a graveyard shift?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: None at all, Mr. Clars!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I was already following a similar schedule before I even applied.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: It wasn't formal work experience, but I'm used to it, so it won't be a problem.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Oh, helping out at the family store, that sort of thing?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Hadiya nods, and Clarson gives her a smile of satisfaction in return.
Great, you won't need much time to adjust. That simplifies things.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Where's the store you were helping out at, if you don't mind me asking?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: 57th Street.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: The very second Hadiya mentions her neighborhood's name, thunder rumbles through the bar's window.
The cheerful smile on the bar owner's face freezes. It is as if he is suddenly unsure what expression he should be making. His mouth lies half-open as he stares awkwardly at Hadiya.
Mr. Clars?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Is... Is there a problem?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: After a few seconds, Clarson finally seems to come to a decision. He puts down Hadiya's files and closes his eyes as he slowly shakes his head.
When he reopens them, his expression has turned grave.
First, let's make sure I didn't mishear you, Miss Talun. You're from 57th Street?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I grew up there.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I haven't been looking for a job in this neighborhood for long, but I don't see how where I'm from should matter.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: But that's exactly the problem.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You really have no idea why everyone you met here turned you down, do you?
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: The evening rain begins to fall outside as she replays today's experiences in her mind.
Our customers are rather fussy, Miss Talun. I'm afraid you're not going to give them a sense of security with the way you look.
attributes.name: Shrewd Bar Owner

attributes.content: And if our customers aren't satisfied, our business will suffer. Sorry, but you'll have to look elsewhere.
attributes.name: Shrewd Bar Owner

attributes.content: Not gonna mince words: we don't hire people like you.
attributes.name: Arrogant Bar Owner

attributes.content: You're tiny minus the horns, and 'tiny' ain't what we put in the job description. Go somewhere else.
attributes.name: Arrogant Bar Owner

attributes.content: We don't have any openings at the moment, unless you're willing to do an unpaid trial period.
attributes.name: Greedy Bar Owner

attributes.content: I have too much to lose if I end up hiring the wrong sort of person, after all.
attributes.name: Greedy Bar Owner

attributes.content: Not happy with that? Then there's nothing to discuss. We don't take your kind here.
attributes.name: Greedy Bar Owner

attributes.content: No way...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: But why?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I'm really sorry, Miss Talun, but I can't hire you either.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Let me give it to you straight:
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: You're not going to find any decent work around here with your background.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: That's ridiculous...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Since long before the business district grew to what it is now, the locals have been feuding with immigrants over land and resources.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Even since the shops opened up, there've been quite a few incidents ending in bloodshed.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Most folks in this city just don't trust immigrants.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: And maybe you haven't noticed, but 57th street is where they all live.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm sure your dad or granddad must've told you stories about the blood, sweat, and tears their generation put into building that neighborhood.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: But to us locals, that place represents nothing but grime and lawlessness.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I always thought life on the outside wouldn't be any different from 57th, just a small change in environment...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Sounds like you grew up sheltered. Good on your family, honestly. But reality loves to disappoint.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Personally, I've got plenty of immigrant friends. I know they don't have it easy.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: But it is what it is. That's just... how this city operates.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: But we've lived here for decades...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: It's not like we're fresh off the convoy!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Yeah, and I didn't even notice a thing until you mentioned where you were from.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: But that won't change where you were born, and it won't change the prejudice my customers will have against you.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm positive that's the only reason those other shops turned you away.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: (Is that why Luftar and the others left Columbia to become mercenaries?)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (Salma worked at that factory for less a month before being sent back. Was it for the same reason?)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (I always thought it was just bad luck...)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I... never imagined it would be like this.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: And there you have it. But don't blame yourself—it's not your fault.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Here, take your things and go, quick.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I'm sorry, but I can't help you any more than that. Besides—
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: It's just about opening hours.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Yeah. Sorry for bothering you, Mr. Clars.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Don't be. Just hurry on back home.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Take care. Looks like it's still raining.
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: Mm...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: *sigh*...
attributes.name: Bar Owner

attributes.content: I still hope you will return to Sargon one day, Hadiya.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: Do you remember the words passed down through our family? We are warriors of Sargon, descendants of the Qarnsayf.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: You must never forget the glorious history our ancestors wrote in the wilds, and their legends known to all.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: For one day our people will return to the wilds, and rebuild our tribe.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: It is a shame that our generation spent all our strength simply finding our footing in Columbia. None of us can return to Sargon.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: But yours still can. I believe you will be able to bring glory to our family.
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: But we've been away from Sargon for too long, baba.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: It's not that I don't want to, but it always feels too soon, like I'm not ready.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: It'd be amazing if I did manage to rebuild the tribe, but what exactly does that even mean?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Do I need a herd of burdenbeasts? Do I need a padishah worth swearing loyalty to? Or do I need to defeat the desert's strongest warriors?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I really have no idea where to even start. It might be best for me to stay in Columbia for now.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Hadiya...
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: I do not want to force you into doing anything, but...
attributes.name: Hadiya's Father

attributes.content: Relax, baba. Wherever I go, I won't disappoint you.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Just have faith in your daughter, okay?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (I thought this was going to be a chance for me to prove myself, but I never expected this.)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (Should I look for work outside the city? No, there's no guarantee it'll be any better than here.)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (But where else can I even go? I can't just give up and go back home like this. That would be pathetic, after everything I said.)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: (Whatever. I can't change what happened today, but I can come up with a new plan, starting tomorrow.)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Hadiya walks alone through the streets at night. All of a sudden, she feels ice-cold rainwater splash across her right leg.
Gah, what's a puddle doing there...? I didn't notice it at all...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Ugh, why is it so hard for me to accept this? I already knew this wasn't going to be a walk in the park.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: But it's... It's just...!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Her hand cannot help but tighten its grip on her sword's hilt. She feels herself begin to shiver uncontrollably, and she knows it is not because of the chilly night.
If only they'd give me a chance...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I'd definitely—
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Hey, you there!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Hands up! Drop the weapons!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Wait! I didn't even do anything!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Don't move! I said drop the weapons!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Settle down, okay? I need these for work! I'm not doing anything bad with them!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I have an open carry permit! There's no need to treat me like this!
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Cut the beastshit! Just put the weapons down, and no sudden movements! Don't make me use force!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Hands on your head, and on your knees, facing the wall!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: You deaf or something?! Follow my orders!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Please don't do this, officer.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Look, I did as you said. I'm just on my way home, honest.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: That's what every criminal says. But what am I supposed to think when you're shuffling around at night with your head down, brandishing a sword?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Name?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Hadiya bint Talun. Sir.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: A name like that... You Sargonian?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: No sir, I'm Columbian. I've lived on 57th Street my entire life.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I'm a full Columbian citizen.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I haven't broken any laws, officer. You can't just treat me like I'm guilty.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Yeah, that's not making you sound any more trustworthy.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: The Iron Hand Gang's been pretty active across the city lately. Most of their crew are Sargonian-Columbians, and they're holed up in 57th Street.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Someone with an innocent face like yours might be casing out joints for them.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Of course not. We've been law-abiding citizens for years. Why would we do that?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I've never even heard of this gang. Now can I—
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Don't move!
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Don't think you can talk your way out of this. What, you think 57th Street's got a squeaky-clean rep?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: It's only common sense to treat you people with suspicion. Just because you live here doesn't give you the right to walk around like you own the place.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: This is slander, officer. I don't care what your reasons are; you can't just paint me with a brush like that—
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Shut it.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: I don't have time to argue with you. And I'm sure neither of us wants this to get ugly.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Hadiya feels the cold police-issue knife pressing against the back of her neck. She stares at the dirty brick wall and begins to shiver uncontrollably again.
You got an ID? Where is it?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Inner jacket pocket. On the left.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Don't move a muscle. I'll get it.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: You'll be leaving here in an ambulance or worse if you try anything funny.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Well shit, there's your open carry permit. The hell is it even for, though? Your carefree days in that shitty block of yours not enough for you?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Sheesh, and that's some spotless paperwork on you. Got your ID too. And what you don't got is any Iron Hand tattoos.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: I'll let you off this time, but don't let me catch you again.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Then can I get up now, officer?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: This is a blatant abuse of power. You can't treat me like this.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Her statement makes the patrol officer laugh out loud.
'Abuse of power'? Against you people? Hah! The only reason we're so busy these days is because we haven't been keeping you little shits in line.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Go ahead, make a report at the station. See if anyone cares what someone like you says.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: The officer puts away his knife, but keeps his hand firmly planted on Hadiya's shoulder, preventing her from getting up.
Count yourself lucky you had all your paperwork on you today.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Otherwise I'd be hauling you back to the station for an interrogation.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Now pick up your toys and get out of here. Don't go swinging them around at night.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: And stay where you belong, you got that?
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: The officer tugs on Hadiya's clothes, intending to pull her up, but she brushes him aside.
...Don't touch me. I'm going.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: She stands up on her own and picks up her swords, now soaked in rainwater.
Hmph.
attributes.name: Columbian Patrol Officer

attributes.content: Baba, was I...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Wrong?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: The rain has ceased. She looks towards the night sky hanging above her home, suddenly lost in thought.
Hadiya sits quietly on her bed, looking at the painting of the wilds hung up on her wall. It was a graduation present from her family, and apparently painted in authentic Sargonian style.
It used to just hang there, silently, with no significance except as a memento. But now, she feels like it is trying to tell her something.
(Maybe I still have a choice.)
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: You there, Hadiya?
Salma?
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Thank goodness you're alright!
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Auntie Tarama told me what you told her at dinner.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: They've gone too far, pushing you around like that!
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: It's fine, habibti. I'm not hurt.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: And now I know how you must've felt back then.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I was so naive, thinking you just happened to meet people who didn't like you.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: I never thought I'd run into the same thing.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: What matters is that you're safe. An encounter like that could've gone a whole lot worse.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: I don't even want to imagine what all our aunts and uncles would do if something actually happened to you.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Yeah yeah, but it didn't, so stop worrying about it.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: More importantly, I need to think about what to do next.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: How about stick to within the neighborhood? They'll never give you a chance out there.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: There's no shame in helping Auntie Tarama out. And it'll be safe too. Safe and happy.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Our aunts and uncles would be able to relax, too.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Spending the rest of my life here...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: A lot of our older peers have already come back, haven't they?
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: It may not be a glamorous life, but it sure beats getting dirty looks wherever you go.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: We've even had our candidates running in district elections.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: We can run this place without having to rely on outsiders, and we won't have to go out and deal with discrimination either.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Just stay here. There's nothing wrong with life on 57th.
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: Sorry, Salma, but I just had a thought.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: As she speaks, she looks towards her sneakers by the door, still soaked from the rain.
You once said this is the only place in all the land that would always have my back.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: But I can't live my entire life here. I was always going to leave one day.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: So if I'd need to bust my butt to earn my place anywhere else anyway...
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Then why try in Sargon? At the very least, I can start fresh there.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Are... Are you serious, Hadiya?
attributes.name: Salma

attributes.content: If you asked me yesterday, I might have hesitated. But this time, I'm serious.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Compared to life in urban Columbia, I didn't know a thing about the wilderness. That was the biggest thing holding me back.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: She reaches out, stroking the painting. She can almost hear the desert it depicts, and a voice calling out her name.
But now, I understand.
attributes.name: Hadiya

attributes.content: Time to go see what a real wilderness is like.
attributes.name: Hadiya
